direct_text_xrefs_into_gap.classification: Kagaimiq-patched forced decode finds many internal branches and one external padding-origin goto to 0x02016c0e; Quarkslab has no trusted direct xref into the hole. Absence of trusted xrefs is not ownership proof, and the returning pre-gap call is enough to refute free-space promotion.

raw_pointer_xrefs_into_gap.classification: little-endian pointer scan is heuristic; exact branch encodings are not raw pointers

ownership_and_executability.reason: The gap is an artifact of Quarkslab exhaustive listing termination after a call at 0x02016a84. That call targets 0x0200ad74, whose decoded body has normal pop-pc returns, so execution resumes at 0x02016a88. The 602 bytes are therefore caller continuation/cold arms, not owned free space.

nearby_function_boundary_evidence.interpretation: 0x02016ce2 is not a proven function entry; it is merely where Quarkslab resumes after a 602-byte missed/cold continuation. The previous four bytes are a call to a returning helper, not an unconditional jump over dead space.

sdk_exact_matches.decision: No public SDK exact match owns or names the gap; SDK evidence neither promotes nor frees it.
sdk_exact_matches.policy: Exact and relocation-aware matches are anchors. A v15 synth/API identity requires two independent specific matches.
